Council meetings are held on the third Monday of each month at the District Council of Grant Council Chamber, 324 Commercial Street West, Mount Gambier, commencing at 5.30pm.  If a scheduled meeting falls on a public holiday, the Council meeting will be held on the following Wednesday unless resolved otherwise by the Council. The Public are welcome to attend however the public may be excluded while business of a kind classified by the regulations as confidential is being considered.
The Council Agenda is available no later than on the Thursday prior to the Council Meeting and can be accessed on Council's website.  The Council Agenda is also available by clicking on the appropriate link below.
The Council Minutes are available within 5 business days after the Council Meeting and will be available on the website or by contacting Council on 8721 0444 or info@dcgrant.sa.gov.au.  The Council Minutes are also available by clicking on the appropriate link below.
Pursuant to Council's Code of Practice for Meeting Procedures (GOVPOL 03), members of the public or community groups / clubs may request to make a deputation or presentation to Council on a specific matter.  Those wishing to do so must complete and submit a Request Form.

Council meetings are held on the third Monday of each month at the District Council of Grant Council Chamber, 324 Commercial Street West, Mount Gambier, commencing at 5.30pm.  If a scheduled meeting falls on a public holiday, the Council meeting will be held on the following Wednesday unless resolved otherwise by the Council. The Public are welcome to attend however the public may be excluded while business of a kind classified by the regulations as confidential is being considered.
The Council Agenda is available no later than on the Thursday prior to the Council Meeting and can be accessed on Council's website.  The Council Agenda is also available by clicking on the appropriate link below.
The Council Minutes are available within 5 business days after the Council Meeting and will be available on the website or by contacting Council on 8721 0444 or info@dcgrant.sa.gov.au.  The Council Minutes are also available by clicking on the appropriate link below.
Pursuant to Council's Code of Practice for Meeting Procedures (GOVPOL 03), members of the public or community groups / clubs may request to make a deputation or presentation to Council on a specific matter.  Those wishing to do so must complete and submit a Request Form.

The Limestone Coast Southern Regional Assessment Panel (RAP) commenced operation as at 1 July 2022. The RAP has been created for the combined areas of the Wattle Range Council, District Council of Grant, District Council of Robe and City of Mount Gambier.
The RAP replaces District Council of Grant's Council Assessment Panel (CAP) to meet the requirements of the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (PDI Act), the Planning and Development and Infrastructure (General) Regulations 2017, and the Planning and Design Code in regional South Australia.
Code of Conduct
The Minister for Planning has adopted a Code of Conduct for Assessment Panel Members to be observed by all members of the RAP. Should you have any concerns or complaints with regard to the conduct of RAP Members, you should direct your complaint to the State Planning Commission on 1800 752 664 or email saplanningcommission@sa.gov.au.  For further information, please see the Complaints Handling Procedure on the PlanSA website.
